title: Handover repository
interface: class HandoverRepository(conn). create(kind, asset_id, employee_id, created_by, protocol_number, note) -> dict (status 'pending'). get(id) -> dict | None. mark_sent(id) -> bool (sets sent_at=now UTC ISO). set_status(id, status, confirmed_at=None, protocol_path=None, decline_reason=None) -> bool (updates only the given optional columns; raises ValueError for a status not in config.HANDOVER_STATUSES; False when unknown id). next_protocol_number(year: int) -> str: 'HP-<year>-<6-digit sequence>' = 1 + count of protocol_numbers starting with 'HP-<year>-'. list_all(status=None, kind=None) -> list[dict] newest first (id DESC). list_for_employee(employee_id) -> list[dict] newest first. list_pending_for_employee(employee_id) -> list[dict] (status 'pending', newest first). list_for_asset(asset_id) -> list[dict] newest first. Dict keys: id, kind, asset_id, employee_id, created_by, status, protocol_number, note, decline_reason, created_at, sent_at, confirmed_at, protocol_path. repositories receive a sqlite3.Connection in the constructor (no default) and call conn.commit() after every write; rows are returned as plain dicts with `is_...`/`active` booleans converted from 0/1

uses.connect/get_db: src/db.py: connect(path) -> sqlite3.Connection (row_factory=sqlite3.Row, schema ensured); get_db() -> current app connection; SCHEMA (tables employees, assets, handovers, assignments, audit_log)
uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES, load_config(overrides) -> dict
